projects.title: Projects
projects.empty: No projects yet. Create one to load your recordings.
setup.title: Setup
setup.intro: PowerEditor needs a few tools on this computer and a way to transcribe the audio.
setup.notReady: A few steps are left before the first project.
setup.hint.ffmpeg: Install FFmpeg 7 or newer, or set its path in Settings › General.
setup.hint.ffprobe: ffprobe ships with FFmpeg; set its path if it is not on PATH.
setup.hint.node: Install Node.js 24. On Windows ARM64, rendering needs an x64 Node (path in General).
setup.hint.pnpm: pnpm is enabled through Corepack, included with Node.js 24.
setup.hint.cuda: Without an NVIDIA GPU, Whisper transcribes on the CPU (slower).
setup.openaiInstead: Rather transcribe with OpenAI? Save the key and pick OpenAI as the transcriber.
settings.title: General
settings.language.hint: ISO code, for example es or en. Empty detects the language.
settings.whisperModel.hint: Empty picks one for this computer (now: {model}).
settings.modelMinConfidence.hint: From 0 to 1. Below it the built-in rule is used and the decision is flagged for review.
settings.autoCta.hint: When processing, adds a graphic over phrases that ask to follow, subscribe or comment.
settings.pathHint: Empty looks the tool up on PATH.
settings.renderMaxConcurrency.hint: 0 picks them from the cores and the free memory.
secret.placeholder: Paste the key; it is never shown again
providers.title: AI providers
providers.intro: Register the models you want to use, with an API key or with a local client already signed in on this computer.
providers.empty: No providers. Without them, every feature uses the built-in rules.
providers.label: Name
providers.cliPath.hint: Optional. Empty looks the client up on PATH.
providers.baseUrl.hint: Optional. Empty uses the provider's official address.
providers.confirmCustomUrl: I confirm this URL is trusted and the key is sent there.
providers.deleteConfirm: Delete {label}? Features that use it go back to the built-in rules.
providers.error.label: Enter a name.
providers.error.baseUrl: Use a URL that starts with http:// or https://.
providers.error.confirm: Confirm the custom URL to send the key there.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.claude: Anthropic does not let other apps use Free, Pro or Max plans on the user's behalf. Use Claude Code signed in by you, or better, an API key.
terms.gemini: With a personal Google account, Gemini CLI has a free quota of 1000 requests per day. A long video can use many.
terms.codex: Codex CLI usage counts against your ChatGPT plan's limits and terms.
features.title: AI features
features.intro: Pick which model answers each decision. The built-in rules need no model and are the fallback when a model fails or is unsure.
features.noModels: Enable models in AI providers to assign them.
steps.needsProject: Open or create a project first

load.title: Load
load.intro: Add your recordings, pick the format and process. PowerEditor finds the takes, cuts the silences and builds a draft.
load.paths.hint: One path per line. Files are read where they are, without copying.
load.name: Project name (optional)
load.script.hint: With the script, PowerEditor can tell better which take is complete.
load.modelMissing: The Whisper model “{model}” is not downloaded: it will download while processing, without a progress bar. Better download it first.
load.keyMissing: Transcribing with OpenAI needs the key.
review.title: Review
review.notAnalyzed: This project has not been processed yet.
review.selectHint: Pick a clip on the timeline to see its details.
overlay.title: Title
export.title: Export
export.intro: The render uses the same composition as the preview, with the voice rebuilt and the loudness normalized.
export.name: File name
export.name.hint: No extension: it is saved as MP4 in the exports folder of the project.
export.name.invalid: Use letters, numbers, spaces, dots, dashes or underscores.
export.quality.draft.hint: Half resolution and a fast encode, to check the cut.
export.quality.high.hint: More bits and a slower encode, to archive or edit again.
providers.keyNotSaved: The provider was saved, but the key was not: {reason} Save again to retry only the key.
panel.label: Edit panels
graphics.autoHint: Created where a call to action was detected.
graphics.keys: On the track: drag to move, drag an edge to resize; ← → move one frame (Shift: 1 s), Delete removes.
graphics.default.title: Your title
graphics.default.name: Your name
graphics.field.subtitle: Subtitle
graphics.field.name: Name
graphics.field.label: Label
audio.normalize: Match the loudness of the recordings
audio.normalize.hint: Brings every source file to the same level before mixing, so a quiet camera does not drop out.
audio.previewNote: The preview changes volume once per frame. The export mixes the audio exactly and normalizes it to the loudness target.
color.selectClip: Pick a clip on the timeline to give it its own look.
color.useGlobal: Use the look of all clips
color.applyToAll.hint.one: {count} clip has a look of its own; applying removes it.
color.applyToAll.hint.other: {count} clips have a look of their own; applying removes it.
color.match.hint: Gains computed at analysis so the cameras look alike. They apply before the look.
edit.shortcuts: Keys: ← → select · Delete remove/restore · [ ] shorten start/end by 0.1 s, Shift extends · Alt-click switches take · Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z undo/redo
edit.selectCut: Pick a clip to change the transition into it.
edit.lineInvalid: This line mixes two recordings and cannot be edited.
edit.linesReadOnly: This project has no transcribed words to edit; process it again.
save.conflictHint: The project changed outside this window since it was opened. Reload it (your recent edits are lost) or keep your version (the other changes are lost).
